title: How we work
html:
How We Work at GTS Dispatch

We do not sell dreams. We run freight realistically and profitably.

Our job is simple: keep your truck moving in lanes that make financial sense for your situation. Every carrier is different. Driver preferences, home time requirements, equipment condition, authority age, and operating goals all matter. We do not apply the same formula to every truck.

No False Promises

For example, if a driver wants to be home every day while expecting $7,000 per week, that combination is rarely realistic in most markets. We believe in education, not illusion.

When carriers understand the market, they make better decisions. Our role is to advise clearly, operate professionally, and maximize profit within your real-world limits.

For Established Authorities

If your authority is active and running, we analyze:

  • Your preferred lanes
  • Your driver schedule
  • Equipment type and condition
  • Current rate trends
  • Deadhead exposure

We then build a practical lane strategy that keeps your truck productive and profitable. We negotiate directly with brokers, manage paperwork, and maintain communication from pickup to delivery.

For New Authorities

New authorities face real filters in today’s dispatch environment.

For Semi and Box Truck carriers, the main challenges are:

  • Limited broker access due to authority age
  • Limited freight availability for 26ft box trucks
  • Personal operating conditions such as home time and equipment limits

We guide new authorities through these filters step by step. We do not rush you into unrealistic expectations. We help you operate within what the market allows and build from there.

Carrier Portal and Document System

Every client receives access to our cloud-based Carrier Portal. This is your organized business workspace.

  • Rate confirmations
  • BOL and POD
  • Fuel receipts
  • Maintenance receipts
  • Settlement worksheets
  • Trip records
  • Driver and truck transaction logs

This helps you stay organized, prepare for tax filing, maintain audit readiness, and track real profitability.

Our Commitment

  • Transparent communication
  • Realistic revenue planning
  • Strong negotiation
  • Continuous learning and adaptation
  • Long term carrier relationships

We do not promise the highest numbers. We focus on consistent and structured growth.

Ready to Run With Structure?

Information Collection And Use

While using our Site, we may ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you. Personally identifiable information may include but is not limited to your name (“Personal Information”).

Log Data

Like many site operators, we collect information that your browser sends whenever you visit our Site (“Log Data”). This Log Data may include information such as your computer’s Internet Protocol (“IP”) address, browser type, browser version, the pages of our Site that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages, and other statistics.

Communications

We may use your Personal Information to contact you with newsletters, marketing, or promotional materials.

Cookies

Cookies are files with small amounts of data, which may include an anonymous unique identifier. Cookies are sent to your browser from a web site and stored on your computer’s hard drive.

Like many sites, we use “cookies” to collect information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Site.

Security

The security of your Personal Information is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage, is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

Changes To This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy is effective as of November 13, 2023, and will remain in effect except with respect to any changes in its provisions in the future, which will be in effect immediately after being posted on this page.

We reserve the right to update or change our Privacy Policy at any time, and you should check this Privacy Policy periodically. Your continued use of the Service after we post any modifications to the Privacy Policy on this page will constitute your acknowledgment of the modifications and your consent to abide and be bound by the modified Privacy Policy.

If we make any material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you either through the email address you have provided us or by placing a prominent notice on our website.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.

title: IFTA Filing
html:
INTERNATIONAL FUEL TAX AGREEMENT (IFTA) FIling

Simplify Your IFTA Filing with GTS

Tax season can be a source of unease for many, especially for business owners. The complexities of tax regulations often feel overwhelming. This is where trusted companies like GTS step in, offering invaluable assistance for International Fuel Tax Agreement (IFTA) filing, easing the process for motor carriers across the United States.

Demystifying IFTA

The International Fuel Tax Agreement, commonly known as IFTA, is a vital accord involving 48 states within the United States. It creates a structured framework for the submission of fuel taxes by motor carriers. The aim is to streamline the tax process and ensure that states receive fair compensation for fuel usage.

Who Needs to File Fuel Tax Returns?

Determining whether you need to register for IFTA is straightforward. You must file for IFTA if you meet these stipulations:

  • You Have a Base State: If you’ve established your trucking company in a particular state, that state becomes your base of operations.

Simplified IFTA Filing

GTS serves as your trusted partner for IFTA filing. We recognize that grappling with tax-related paperwork and regulations can be overwhelming, particularly when you’re already managing a bustling trucking operation. With our IFTA filing assistance, you can rest assured that your IFTA obligations are in capable hands.

What We Offer:

  • IFTA Activation: We assist in activating your IFTA account, ensuring compliance with tax regulations.

  • Preparation: We diligently prepare all necessary documents, guaranteeing accurate and timely filings.

  • Peace of Mind: With GTS handling your IFTA filing, you can focus on the road, knowing that your tax responsibilities are professionally addressed.

  • Compliance: Our expertise in IFTA regulations ensures that you remain in compliance with both state and federal tax laws.

At GTS, we’re more than just a truck dispatch company. We are your partner in simplifying the complexities of the trucking industry. With our IFTA filing assistance, you can seamlessly navigate the tax landscape, freeing up your time to concentrate on what you excel at – driving and expanding your business. title: FAQ
html:
F.A.Q.

1. What is truck dispatching, and how can it benefit my trucking business?

Truck dispatching is a service that helps trucking companies efficiently manage their operations, including load booking, route planning, and administrative tasks. It can benefit your business by saving time, reducing administrative burdens, and ensuring your trucks stay on the road, maximizing your profits.

How does your dispatch service work?

Our dispatch service involves assigning dedicated dispatchers to work closely with your drivers. They handle load booking, route planning, and all necessary administrative tasks, allowing you and your drivers to focus on driving. We offer customized solutions tailored to your specific needs.

3. What types of trucking businesses do you serve?

We work with a wide range of trucking businesses, from owner-operators to large fleets. Whether you have a few trucks or an extensive fleet, our dispatch services are designed to meet your needs.

4. Do you offer load booking services, and how do you find loads for my trucks?

Yes, we provide load booking services. Our experienced dispatchers use load boards, industry connections, and market knowledge to find the best available loads for your trucks, ensuring you get quality routes and competitive rates.

5. How do you ensure my drivers are paid accurately and on time?

We offer services for preparing driver settlements for payroll. Our team accurately calculates driver settlements, including regular pay, bonuses, and deductions, ensuring your drivers are compensated promptly and fairly.

6. Can I choose the routes and areas my drivers operate in?

Absolutely. We work closely with you to customize routes and areas based on your preferences and business goals. You have control over the lanes your drivers operate in.

7. Do you handle IFTA (International Fuel Tax Agreement) filings?

Yes, we provide IFTA filing assistance, ensuring that you are in compliance with tax regulations and that your fuel taxes are submitted accurately and on time.

8. What sets your truck dispatch service apart from others in the industry?

Our commitment to providing comprehensive, personalized dispatch services, compliance with industry regulations, and a strong focus on customer satisfaction distinguish us from the competition. We are dedicated to simplifying the complexities of the trucking industry for our clients.

9. How can I get started with your truck dispatch services?

Getting started is easy. Simply reach out to us through our contact page, and we’ll be in touch to discuss your specific needs and tailor our services to your business.

10. What are your service fees, and how does your pricing work?

Our service fees vary based on the scope of services you require and the size of your fleet. We offer competitive pricing and can provide you with a customized quote once we understand your needs.

YOUR DEDICATED DISPATCH

“We offer a comprehensive truck dispatching service that efficiently manages all essential back-office operations, allowing you and your drivers to focus on the demands of the road. We provide invaluable support to truck drivers operating small trucking businesses, helping them streamline load bookings and back-office processes. While some dispatchers exclusively specialize in load booking, GTS provides a diverse range of services, including Invoice Management, Load Payment Collection, Drivers Pay Settlement, and IFTA Tax preparation.

GTS steps in to provide assistance. Our process is straightforward: your dedicated truck dispatcher collaborates with you, adhering to your preferences. We do not enforce forced dispatches. Our aim is to help you maximize your earnings and tailor routes to your preferred schedule, whether it’s a daily, every other day, or bi-weekly schedule. Our highly experienced load dispatchers are well-versed in practices such as Sleeper Split/Off-duty Split, Short Haul Exemptions, Adverse Conditions, and various other expert decisions to design routes that align with your financial objectives. You can count on us to ensure fair compensation for drivers with regard to Detention, Layovers, and TONU (Truck Order Not Used).”

What Sets Us Apart?

At our truck dispatch services company, we pride ourselves on offering a wide range of services that distinguish us from the competition:
